claude.performance_metric: no divestiture; assets retained and fully integrated (goodwill not impaired as of Sep 30, 2021; one-time $4.8M CARES-Act NOL tax benefit FY2020)
claude.rationale: The slice documents no disruption at any interface: the acquired business was fully absorbed into the surviving registrant's single community-banking segment, with the "Blue Hills" name persisting only in a charitable foundation, indicating routine integration rather than product/process incoherence (p4=0). No process/organization fracture is documented—goodwill was tested as not impaired as of September 30, 2021, and no BHB-attributable merger/acquisition expenses (severance, branch-closure, conversion costs) were reported in 2020 or 2021 (p5=0). The only realized facts are a one-time $4.8M FY2020 tax benefit and continued pension-plan accounting through FY2021; there is no evidence of divestiture, write-down, or operational breakdown, and no segment-level record exists because the acquired registrant deregistered shortly after close.
